title: ayenia elliptica
intro: Ayenia elliptica, commonly known as Mexican stonebreaker, is a plant species belonging to the family Malpighiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve gastrointestinal issues, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Ayenia elliptica include its potential to treat conditions such as dyspepsia, gastritis, and ulcers, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may also possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
